description: Remove a subscription and drop its pending deliveries. The secret goes with it, so this is not a way to pause: recreating means a new secret and a change on the customer's server. Use impreza_update_webhook with active:false when the endpoint is only temporarily down. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.
name: impreza_delete_webhook
title: Delete webhook
